description: Phase 3.3 gate. Each benchmark VECTOR question (B01-B08 from data/benchmark/questions.md) must surface an acceptable source chunk within the top-k results of retrieve_vector. 'gold_chunks' lists every chunk that legitimately answers the question (a doc that split contributes more than one; some questions are answered by either of two docs). Pass = at least one gold chunk in the top rank_within.
